# Switch NX2 - read when the Lichii GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eden/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one.
#
# Performance tuning configuration for AMD Ryzen 5 3600 & Radeon RX 5700 XT (60+ FPS Target)

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread (SPLIT=2 delivers up to +54% FPS alone).
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Native present release queue: return release syncpoint fences instead of blocking until vblank.
# Prevents games (e.g. Mario Kart World, Zelda) from detecting slow CPU frames and locking to 30 FPS!
EDEN_NX2_PRESENT_QUEUE=1

# Overlap frame preparation: the game prepares the next frame while the GPU finishes the current one.
EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=1

# Asynchronous shader discard: skip stalling while background pipelines compile, eradicating stutter.
EDEN_NX2_ASYNC_DISCARD=1

# Keep buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2: prevents PCIe saturation and mutex contention.
EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=0

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1
